# Royal Marriage pirate_african Subject
country_event = {
	id = cosmo_piratepu_events.1103
	title = cosmo_piratepu_events.1103.t
	desc = cosmo_piratepu_events.1103.d
	picture = cosmogfx_PIRATE_QUEENS_MENU_1A_1_eventPicture

	is_triggered_only = yes		

	immediate = {
	hidden_effect = {
				random_known_country = {
				limit = {
					has_opinion_modifier = {
						who = ROOT
						modifier = cosmo_sending_proposal
					}
				}
					save_event_target_as = proposalcountry
				}
				random_subject_country = {
			limit = {
		cosmo_asian_personal_union_subject_trigger = yes

				OR = {
				primary_culture = pirate_african
				#primary_culture = leonese
				}
			}
					save_event_target_as = proposalcountry
				}										
		}
	}	

		option = {
		name = cosmo_piratepu_events.1103.a 
		trigger = {
		has_regency = no 	
		OR = {
			has_consort = no	
			has_estate = estate_harem 	
			has_estate = estate_wives 	
			has_estate = estate_forbiddenpalace 	
			has_estate = estate_ooku 				
		}
		}
		set_ruler_flag = royal_marriage_ruler
		event_target:proposalcountry = {
		#proposal country
		country_event = {#royal wedding FROM
			id = cosmo_piratepu_events.11098
			}
		}				
	}
		option = {
		name = cosmo_piratepu_events.1103.b 
		trigger = {
			has_heir = yes
		NOT = {
			has_ruler_modifier = cosmo_heir_married
		}
		}
		add_ruler_modifier = {
			name = cosmo_heir_married
			duration = -1  
			desc = cosmo_heir_married_DESC

				}		
		set_ruler_flag = royal_marriage_heir
		event_target:proposalcountry = {
		#proposal country
		country_event = {#royal wedding FROM
			id = cosmo_piratepu_events.11098
			}
		}
		event_target:proposalcountry = {
			remove_opinion = {
					who = ROOT
					modifier = cosmo_sending_proposal
				}
		}						
	}
		option = {#uncleson
		name = cosmo_piratepu_events.1103.c 
		trigger = {
			has_heir = yes
		NOT = {
			has_ruler_modifier = cosmo_heir_married
		}
		}
		add_ruler_modifier = {
			name = cosmo_heir_married
			duration = -1  
			desc = cosmo_heir_married_DESC

				}		
		set_ruler_flag = royal_marriage_uncleson
		event_target:proposalcountry = {
		#proposal country
		country_event = {#royal wedding FROM
			id = cosmo_piratepu_events.11098
			}
		}
		event_target:proposalcountry = {
			remove_opinion = {
					who = ROOT
					modifier = cosmo_sending_proposal
				}
		}						
	}	
		option = {#reject
		name = cosmo_piratepu_events.1103.7 
		event_target:proposalcountry = {
			remove_opinion = {
					who = ROOT
					modifier = cosmo_sending_proposal
				}
		}						
	}
		
}

# Royal Marriage pirate_african Subject
country_event = {
	id = cosmo_piratepu_events.1101
	title = cosmo_piratepu_events.1101.t
	desc = cosmo_piratepu_events.1101.d
	picture = cosmogfx_PIRATE_QUEENS_MENU_1A_1_eventPicture

	is_triggered_only = yes		

	immediate = {
	hidden_effect = {
		every_owned_province = {
			limit = {
			OR = {
				superregion = eastern_europe_superregion
				superregion = europe_superregion
				superregion = near_east_superregion
				superregion = caucasia_region
			}	
			}
			set_province_flag = pirate_african_honeymoon_possible_here
		}
		every_subject_country = {
		every_owned_province = {
			limit = {
			OR = {
				superregion = eastern_europe_superregion
				superregion = europe_superregion
				superregion = near_east_superregion
				superregion = caucasia_region
			}	
			}
			set_province_flag = pirate_african_honeymoon_possible_here
		}			
		}
				random_province = {
				limit = {
					has_province_flag = pirate_african_honeymoon_possible_here
					country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT 
				}
					save_event_target_as = honeymoonprovince
				}
				random_province = {
				limit = {
					has_province_flag = pirate_african_honeymoon_possible_here
					country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT 
					has_port = yes 					
				}
					save_event_target_as = honeymoonprovince
				}				
				random_province = {
				limit = {
					has_province_flag = pirate_african_honeymoon_possible_here
					country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT 
					province_has_center_of_trade_of_level = 1					
				}
					save_event_target_as = honeymoonprovince
				}
				random_province = {
				limit = {
					has_province_flag = pirate_african_honeymoon_possible_here
					country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT 
					province_has_center_of_trade_of_level = 2					
				}
					save_event_target_as = honeymoonprovince
				}
				random_province = {
				limit = {
					has_province_flag = pirate_african_honeymoon_possible_here
					country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT 
					province_has_center_of_trade_of_level = 2
					has_port = yes 					
				}
					save_event_target_as = honeymoonprovince
				}
				random_subject_country = {
				limit = {
					capital_scope = {
			OR = {
				superregion = eastern_europe_superregion
				superregion = europe_superregion
				superregion = near_east_superregion
				superregion = caucasia_region
			}
						has_province_flag = pirate_african_honeymoon_possible_here
					}
				}
				capital_scope = {
					save_event_target_as = honeymoonprovince
				}	
				}										
		}
	}	

		option = {
		name = cosmo_piratepu_events.1101.a 
		FROM = {
			capital_scope = { #testdelete
			set_province_flag = pirate_african_honeymoon_first_stop	
			}
		}
		create_marriage = FROM
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_ruler_flag = royal_marriage_ruler
			}				
		define_consort = {
			country_of_origin = FROM
			dynasty = FROM
			religion = FROM
			culture = FROM
			female = yes
		}
		set_consort_flag = cosmo_consort
		set_consort_flag = cosmo_pirate_1a
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				FROM = {
					NOT = {
				cosmo_asian_personal_union_subject_trigger = yes
					}
				}				
				}
				create_subject = { 
					subject_type = cosmo_asian_personal_union_I	
					subject = FROM	
					}
				join_all_offensive_wars_of = FROM
				join_all_defensive_wars_of = FROM	
				FROM = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_reform = pirate_republic_reform
					}
					hidden_effect = {
					change_government = monarchy 
					}
					add_government_reform = cosmo_pirate_kingdom 					
				}
				}	
			}
				country_event = {#honeymoon first
					id = cosmo_piratepu_events.11031
					days = 30
					random = 15					
					}
		hidden_effect = {
				trigger_switch = {
		on_trigger = has_ruler_flag
		royal_marriage_ruler = {
			set_country_flag = pirate_african_ruler_honeymoon
			clr_ruler_flag = royal_marriage_ruler
			}
		cosmo_heir_married = {
			set_country_flag = pirate_african_heir_honeymoon
			clr_ruler_flag = royal_marriage_heir
			}
		royal_marriage_uncleson = {
			set_country_flag = pirate_african_uncle_honeymoon
			clr_ruler_flag = royal_marriage_uncleson
			}
		}
		}			
	}		
}

		ai = no

	}
		}

			days = 7
		}

				}
			}
					save_event_target_as = personalunion
					capital_scope = { save_event_target_as = pucapital }	
		}
		}
	}

		which = cosmoPirateQTwoCCounter

		}
		if = {

			}

	}

				}

	title = cosmo_piratepu_events.3303.t
	desc = cosmo_piratepu_events.3303.d
	picture = cosmogfx_PIRATE_QUEENS_MENU_3C_1_eventPicture

	is_triggered_only = yes		

	immediate = {
	hidden_effect = {
				random_known_country = {
				limit = {
					has_opinion_modifier = {
						who = ROOT
						modifier = cosmo_sending_proposal
					}
				}
					save_event_target_as = proposalcountry
				}
				random_subject_country = {
			limit = {
		cosmo_asian_personal_union_subject_trigger = yes

				OR = {
				primary_culture = pirate_asian
				}
			}
					save_event_target_as = proposalcountry
				}										
		}
	}	

		option = {
		name = cosmo_piratepu_events.3303.a 
		trigger = {
		has_regency = no 	
		OR = {
			has_consort = no	
			has_estate = estate_harem 	
			has_estate = estate_wives 	
			has_estate = estate_forbiddenpalace 	
			has_estate = estate_ooku 				
		}
		}
		set_ruler_flag = royal_marriage_ruler
		event_target:proposalcountry = {
		#proposal country
		country_event = {#royal wedding FROM
			id = cosmo_piratepu_events.33098
			}
		}				
	}
		option = {
		name = cosmo_piratepu_events.3303.b 
		trigger = {
			has_heir = yes
		NOT = {
			has_ruler_modifier = cosmo_heir_married
		}
		}
		add_ruler_modifier = {
			name = cosmo_heir_married
			duration = -1  
			desc = cosmo_heir_married_DESC

				}		
		set_ruler_flag = royal_marriage_heir
		event_target:proposalcountry = {
		#proposal country
		country_event = {#royal wedding FROM
			id = cosmo_piratepu_events.33098
			}
		}
		event_target:proposalcountry = {
			remove_opinion = {
					who = ROOT
					modifier = cosmo_sending_proposal
				}
		}						
	}
		option = {#uncleson
		name = cosmo_piratepu_events.3303.c 
		trigger = {
			has_heir = yes
		NOT = {
			has_ruler_modifier = cosmo_heir_married
		}
		}
		add_ruler_modifier = {
			name = cosmo_heir_married
			duration = -1  
			desc = cosmo_heir_married_DESC

				}		
		set_ruler_flag = royal_marriage_uncleson
		event_target:proposalcountry = {
		#proposal country
		country_event = {#royal wedding FROM
			id = cosmo_piratepu_events.33098
			}
		}
		event_target:proposalcountry = {
			remove_opinion = {
					who = ROOT
					modifier = cosmo_sending_proposal
				}
		}						
	}	
		option = {#reject
		name = cosmo_piratepu_events.3303.7 
		event_target:proposalcountry = {
			remove_opinion = {
					who = ROOT
					modifier = cosmo_sending_proposal
				}
		}						
	}
		
}

# Royal Marriage pirate_asian Subject
country_event = {
	id = cosmo_piratepu_events.3301
	title = cosmo_piratepu_events.3301.t
	desc = cosmo_piratepu_events.3301.d
	picture = cosmogfx_PIRATE_QUEENS_MENU_3C_1_eventPicture

	is_triggered_only = yes		

	immediate = {
	hidden_effect = {
		every_owned_province = {
			limit = {
			OR = {
				superregion = eastern_europe_superregion
				superregion = europe_superregion
				superregion = near_east_superregion
				superregion = caucasia_region
			}	
			}
			set_province_flag = pirate_asian_honeymoon_possible_here
		}
		every_subject_country = {
		every_owned_province = {
			limit = {
			OR = {
				superregion = eastern_europe_superregion
				superregion = europe_superregion
				superregion = near_east_superregion
				superregion = caucasia_region
			}	
			}
			set_province_flag = pirate_asian_honeymoon_possible_here
		}			
		}
				random_province = {
				limit = {
					has_province_flag = pirate_asian_honeymoon_possible_here
					country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT 
				}
					save_event_target_as = honeymoonprovince
				}
				random_province = {
				limit = {
					has_province_flag = pirate_asian_honeymoon_possible_here
					country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT 
					has_port = yes 					
				}
					save_event_target_as = honeymoonprovince
				}				
				random_province = {
				limit = {
					has_province_flag = pirate_asian_honeymoon_possible_here
					country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT 
					province_has_center_of_trade_of_level = 1					
				}
					save_event_target_as = honeymoonprovince
				}
				random_province = {
				limit = {
					has_province_flag = pirate_asian_honeymoon_possible_here
					country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT 
					province_has_center_of_trade_of_level = 2					
				}
					save_event_target_as = honeymoonprovince
				}
				random_province = {
				limit = {
					has_province_flag = pirate_asian_honeymoon_possible_here
					country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT 
					province_has_center_of_trade_of_level = 2
					has_port = yes 					
				}
					save_event_target_as = honeymoonprovince
				}
				random_subject_country = {
				limit = {
					capital_scope = {
			OR = {
				superregion = eastern_europe_superregion
				superregion = europe_superregion
				superregion = near_east_superregion
				superregion = caucasia_region
			}
						has_province_flag = pirate_asian_honeymoon_possible_here
					}
				}
				capital_scope = {
					save_event_target_as = honeymoonprovince
				}	
				}										
		}
	}	

		option = {
		name = cosmo_piratepu_events.3301.a 
		FROM = {
			capital_scope = { #testdelete
			set_province_flag = pirate_asian_honeymoon_first_stop	
			}
		}
		create_marriage = FROM
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_ruler_flag = royal_marriage_ruler
			}				
		define_consort = {
			country_of_origin = FROM
			dynasty = FROM
			religion = FROM
			culture = FROM
			female = yes
		}
		set_consort_flag = cosmo_consort
		set_consort_flag = cosmo_pirate_3c
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				FROM = {
					NOT = {
				cosmo_asian_personal_union_subject_trigger = yes
					}
				}				
				}
				create_subject = { 
					subject_type = cosmo_asian_personal_union_I	
					subject = FROM	
					}
				join_all_offensive_wars_of = FROM
				join_all_defensive_wars_of = FROM	
				FROM = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_reform = pirate_republic_reform
					}
					hidden_effect = {
					change_government = monarchy 
					}
					add_government_reform = cosmo_pirate_kingdom 					
				}
				}	
			}
				country_event = {#honeymoon first
					id = cosmo_piratepu_events.33031
					days = 30
					random = 15					
					}
		hidden_effect = {
				trigger_switch = {
		on_trigger = has_ruler_flag
		royal_marriage_ruler = {
			set_country_flag = pirate_asian_ruler_honeymoon
			clr_ruler_flag = royal_marriage_ruler
			}
		cosmo_heir_married = {
			set_country_flag = pirate_asian_heir_honeymoon
			clr_ruler_flag = royal_marriage_heir
			}
		royal_marriage_uncleson = {
			set_country_flag = pirate_asian_uncle_honeymoon
			clr_ruler_flag = royal_marriage_uncleson
			}
		}
		}			
	}		
}
